msg: RULING ADR 0026 P1d (filename collision). (c) YES, inside 0026 before landing. (a) ATOMIC EXCLUSIVE PUBLISH, not noclobber: write the tic to a temp file OUTSIDE tics.d on the same filesystem (git: $_gd/.git/tics-tmp/, spool: a sibling tics.tmp/), then publish with 'ln tmp final' (a hard link is atomic AND fails if the name exists), retry with a new suffix on failure, rm tmp. Never append to an existing tic file. Name = <ts>-<session>-<host>-<pid>-<counter>-<rand> (host ALWAYS, also when session is set: two hosts with one path would be an add/add rebase conflict). Why not noclobber '>': the file exists EMPTY then fills, and since every publish now runs 'add -A tics.d', a concurrent emitter's half-written tic can be committed and pushed TRUNCATED, then modified — breaking append-only/disjoint paths. (b) YES, both readers parse line by line and keep every valid JSON line — and are not silent: count unparsable lines and show 'N unreadable tic line(s) skipped' on log/board. Pins to add: P1d-4 a reader racing an emitter never sees a partial tic, and a concurrent publish never commits a partial file (all committed blobs parse).
